<h1 id="Measurement-Science-Deep-Dive-%E2%80%94-groundSpring">Measurement Science Deep Dive — groundSpring<a class="anchor-link" href="#Measurement-Science-Deep-Dive-%E2%80%94-groundSpring">¶</a></h1><p>The gap between what models predict and what instruments measure.

<li><strong>Temporal Dynamics</strong> — How systems drift over time</li>

</ol>

<h2 id="Anderson-Localization:-The-Flagship-Domain">Anderson Localization: The Flagship Domain<a class="anchor-link" href="#Anderson-Localization:-The-Flagship-Domain">¶</a></h2><p>Anderson localization — how disorder causes wave functions to

4 scientific domains: pure math (Exp 008, 009, 012, 018),
uncertainty bridging (Exp 015, 022), immunology (Exp 033),
and hardware (Exp 028, NPU classification).</p>
